question: T12 (task-1da13692169f8f73, task-ec9304ac83796f57, task-90c702f348286912): a block on the Scrolling block's top row and columns that ends above its foot, as the foot grows; the phone stack after Text Size steps and after a desktop drag whose last step is a fall. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a second block added after it (a second Scrolling block, or a Text block in B), made on the desktop (desktop both 1/2/3/26, or 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10; phone 1/2/3/10 and 3/2/5/10), so the section follows the desktop on the phone. 'place i r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes block i by hand first. Select the Scrolling block, Edit, Design ('open'), presses on Wave Intensity (179 is the press at the range's end, read as 180) or on a Text Size button, or a real drag through one DevTools session (a press on the range at its first value, a move to each next value gap ms apart, quick reads in that session: 'held <n> <value> +<ms>' that many ms after the n-th move, 'up +<ms>' after the let go). A: the first made 1/2/4/26 over the second (1/2/3/26), presses 150, 0, 180. B: the Text block made 1/2/3/10, the Scrolling block 1/2/5/10, presses 180, 0. C: as A, a drag 0>30>...>120>...>0>...>120 at 300 ms, a read 80 ms after each move. D: presses 150, Medium, Small, Large text size. E: a drag 0>...>120>...>0 at 300 ms; F the same at 1500 ms with reads 80 and 1200 ms after each move; G a drag 0>...>120>90>60 at 300 ms, reads 80, 1000 and 2500 ms after the last. H (written as a prediction first): presses 150, 60, 0. I (the same): presses 150, Large, Medium, Small text size. Then Escape (let go, 'go') and Cmd+Z ('Z', only while the section is not back as built), a read after each. R1 ran ABCDE; R2 GFEDCBA (A stopped at its 'open': the panel showed no Design tab, so A has no R2 reads); R3 AHI; R4 IHA. Two earlier R2 starts found the site frame showing its Private Site page and stopped before entering edit mode; a reload of the pages panel brought it back. Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: As CAP-T12HELD: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section in the page's order (me: the selected Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges and Text Size buttons (ctl); 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus, Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]), its input, change and pointer events by the page's clock (log). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z).
answer: A, desktop: the second Scrolling block on 1/2/3/26 under the first made 1/2/4/26 by hand. 150 takes the first to 1/2/6/26 and leaves the second on 1/2/3/26 (neither stretched nor moved), the section 10 rows; 0 takes the first to 1/2/2/26, 7 rows; 180 then takes the first to 1/2/7/26 and stretches the second, now ending below the old foot, by the foot's 5 rows to 1/2/8/26, 12 rows. So a block on the top row and columns is stretched only when it ends on or below the old foot.

B, desktop: a Text block on 1/2/3/10 under the Scrolling block made 1/2/5/10. 180 takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/7/10 and leaves the Text block on 1/2/3/10; 0 takes it to 1/2/2/10 and the Text block stays.

C, desktop, as A, a drag 0 to 120, back to 0 and out to 120 at 300 ms: held, the first stays 1/2/4/26 at 30 and 60 (a growth leaves the rows made by hand), 1/2/5/26 at 90 and 120, the second staying 1/2/3/26; back down 1/2/4/26 at 60, 1/2/3/26 at 30 and 0; out again, 60 takes the first to 1/2/4/26 and the second, ending on the old foot, to 1/2/4/26, then both 1/2/5/26. Let go: both 1/2/5/26, the phone stack as built.

D, desktop, two Scrolling blocks as added: 150 takes both to 1/2/6/26; Medium text size both to 1/2/8/26; Small takes the first to 1/2/6/26 and leaves the second 1/2/8/26, the phone stack as built; Large takes the first to 1/2/10/26 and stretches the second to 1/2/12/26, and the phone stack turns: the second first (1/2/3/10), the first 3/2/5/10.

The phone stack, on the desktop (D, E, F, G, H, I with CAP-T12TWIN v and CAP-T12PAUSEBACK W): each Wave Intensity or Text Size step sets it from the desktop as it was before that step, not after. A step whose before had the two blocks on the same area keeps it (v at 0, D Small, G's 60, E's 60 on the way back); a step whose before had the first inside the second turns it, the second first, even when the step moves only the first: E and F at 30 on the way back (the first from 1/2/4/26 to 1/2/3/26, the second 1/2/5/26), H at 0 after 150 and 60, I at Small after Large and Medium. Written as predictions before H and I were read (H, I: the second first); both came out so, R3 and R4 alike.

E, a drag 0 to 120 and back to 0 at 300 ms: both 1/2/4/26 at 60 and 1/2/5/26 at 90 and 120; back down, the first 1/2/5/26 at 90 and 1/2/4/26 at 60 with the stack as built, then 1/2/3/26 at 30 with the stack turned (read 80 ms after the move), and so at 0 and after the let go (no change event: the value is back at its start). F, the same at 1500 ms: the same areas and the turn at 30, already 80 ms after the move; at 60 the stack stays as built 1200 ms on. G, the drag let go on 60 after 120 and 90: the first 1/2/4/26, the second 1/2/5/26, the stack as built 2500 ms held and after the let go (a change event fires).

H, presses 150, 60, 0: 150 both 1/2/6/26; 60 the first 1/2/3/26, the second stays, the stack as built; 0 the first stays 1/2/3/26 and the stack turns. I, presses 150, Large, Medium, Small: Large both 1/2/10/26; Medium the first 1/2/7/26, the stack as built; Small the first 1/2/5/26 and the stack turns.

Escape keeps every area. Cmd+Z of a step that lowered Wave Intensity or Text Size does not give back the areas before it: A's third Cmd+Z (back before 150) gives the first 1/2/2/26, not the 1/2/4/26 it was made; C's first (back before the drag) 1/2/2/26; H's first (back to 60) the first 1/2/4/26 and the second 1/2/7/26, where 60 had left 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/6/26; I's first (back to Medium) 1/2/8/26 and 1/2/11/26. Each Cmd+Z gives back the phone stack of its step. R1 and R2 read alike in every read of B to E (F and G were read in R2 only), A in R1 and R3, H and I in R3 and R4, apart from Undo and Redo at a plan's start.
Not read: the phone view; a block on the top row and columns that is not a Scrolling or Text block; the stack with three blocks; item changes (only Text Size).
